title: Fixed Open Drawer Box Easel
description: One original complete fixed open box easel: shallow whole drawing box with front drawer bay, continuous extended open drawer and proud front pull, three whole splayed legs with finite feet and pivots, raised tilted box lid supporting a complete blank panel on a ledge and upper retainer, and paired fixed lid stays. New box-easel structure rather than old A-frame/H-frame rails or deep travel case. One whole model, zero scenes. Static shown pose only; no sliding, folding, clamping, adjustable height, arbitrary canvas compatibility, load, stability, manufacturing or safety claim.
